question: How much money is planned for ION light rail to Cambridge?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: The 2027 forecast includes $85 million for Cambridge light rail project development. [1] The city documents do not show the future yearly costs to run it. You can email Transportation Services at 2027PlanAndBudget@regionofwaterloo.ca for more information.

statements.text: The 2027 forecast includes $85 million for project development of the Cambridge light rail line.
